1.) CS Efficiency has been increased.

2.) We have added a couple of our final release scenarios that occur at the disturbance house to the game early in this update. We have done this as a thank-you for everyone's patience whilst we fixed the bug that was affecting new players who could not play the game. notes.title: New Patch Update
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Thank you for the feedback over the past few weeks and apologies for any disappointments.
The bugs were found within our build after testing the recent graphic driver updates. 
We've been busy working on the game after the difficulties in the load up and locker room scenes.
We have lowered GPU power consumption and hopefully get the game to a working state. With further improvements will be carried out while we remain in Early Access.
We'll be updating to the latest long term support game build and improving the quality for you to enjoy.

Thanks again community, Stay Safe.

notes.title: Small Update 27th May 2021
notes.notes:
Improved The Police Officers walk arrest.

A few Bug fixes and minor optimizations.

We are about one third of the way in completing our random extra scenes which will be added to the game for our final release.

Stay safe

notes.title: Update for 13th May 21
notes.notes:
Small Update

Added Police Officer Walk arrest. Now when you select the handcuffs Your police colleague will now always effect an arrest once the main Civilian has been neutralized. Beware that he may get in the way if the other Civilians are still causing a disturbance.  He knows no fear! 

You can select the Handcuffs at any time and The Police Officer will wait until force is used.

We are currently working on a number of set scenes which will appear randomly. They will be different to the main play through and add to your experience in the disturbance house.

notes.title: Update Notes for 23rd April
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Small update adding some more alternate endings.

Graphics tweaked.

Have a great weekend. We will be bringing in some more bits soon

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello All,

We've increased the challenge to you now Officers. Be on your guard and have your wits about you.

Up to X4 characters in the room at one time. Assess the threat if any.

Your old sweat partner may now have remembered to bring some of his kit with him, but don't always count on him!

Fixed an error where the game was failing you for drawing a pistol, ditching it and then using cs. 
All now fixed.

Looking to further improve the oculus trigger, adjustments have been done.

Animation blends have been carried out to improve in some areas.

More content is next on the list.

Hope you enjoy and any feedback will be really useful.

Stay Safe Officers

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
This small update has added an Easy mode which won't fail you for drawing your weapons as a show of force at any inappropriate time. This is the default setting as it has been reported to us that it is taking away the fun from the game and some players wanted to role-play holding a weapon in a concealed way.

Normal mode will still fail you for drawing your weapons at inappropriate times.

We have added decal bullet recognition on the new wall textures.

Shadows have been fixed on the Civilian for when he runs away.

notes.title: Graphics and Optimization Update Now Live
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thank you for your patience this month. We have been busy Optimizing our entire game to produce a better frame rate and overall appearance of the game.

The room appearance is now randomized and the characters spawn with more accessories.
 
[i]At the moment we only have one graphics setting so Low Medium and High settings are currently disabled[/i]

We will be focusing on adding more random scenarios next.

Stay Safe Officers

notes.title: Small Update - 29th Jan 2021
notes.notes:
[u][b]CS Upgraded[/b][/u]

[i]The CS spray has been tweaked as requested from feedback from the community. It is now more powerful and visible.
[/i]
[u][b]Update from last week[/b][/u]

[i]1.) Last week there were a few updates. We have added a second AI Character to the scene. We hope to add a couple more characters in the future to increase the challenge.

2.)We have also amended the Police belt so that the weapons respawn after you drop them.  The CS and Pistol will respawn instantly. The Taser will respawn instantly also so long as you haven't fired it. If you have fired the Taser it will show as transparent until the 5 seconds reload time has expired.[/i]

From feedback from the reviews we will now be looking at improving performance and visuals again.

Speak soon and stay safe

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
1.) Changed how the player activates the scenario From "Open the Door" to "Knock on the door" to start the play through. The door will swing open just before you connect.
2.) Lowered some loud audio in game
3.) Fixed an issue where if the police officer is CS gassed in the face and the player makes an arrest on the next level the Police Officer talks over himself twice and fails the player even though the arrest was lawful.
4.) Updated the store page


Thanks for all the feedback so far. We will be prioritizing a graphics overhaul along with making the UI and Audio more pleasant.
